verdict.rationale: dlt is itself an official open-source Python library, installable via pip, with documented pipeline APIs (dlt.pipeline, pipeline.run, pipeline.dataset()) that developers and coding agents build against directly. The evidence covers only a single Python library, so this is partial rather than complete coverage of an SDK offering. missing for 10: official SDKs beyond Python (other languages), a documented SDK or client for the dltHub managed platform API (no OpenAPI spec found), and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven SDK use.
